Name: Adopt Morgan - SVE and RRRR
Author: oriionStar
Description:
Allows the farmer to let Morgan spend the evenings at the farmhouse after marrying Magnus, it's been made with Jello's Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped mod in mind.

Just a silly little mod I made out of self indulgence and the small ick of Magnus leaving a whole child alone in a tower after getting married.

If you have any issues or questions, please feel free to let me know.
Also please report typos if you catch them. Please.
[b]
[/b][b][center][size=4]This mod adds:[/size][/center][/b]

[list]
[*]The hability to take Morgan in during the evenings when the Wizard returns home after marriage, and let's them commute together in the mornings.
[*]Extra dialogue for Morgan when staying at the farm.
[*]5 New events.
[/list]
[b][center] [/center][/b][center][size=4][b]﻿R[/b][b]equirements:[/b][/size][/center][b][center][/center][/b][list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded.
[*]Have More Kids.
[*]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped.
[*]Content Patcher.
[*]SMAPI.
[/list]                                           ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿        [center][size=4] [b]﻿﻿Event list[/b][/size][/center]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Letters - Must have 3 harts with both Morgan and the Wizard - between 8:00am and 5:00pm - Wizard Tower[/size]
[*][size=2]Home Sick - Must have 10 hearts with the Wizard and 3 with Morgan - between 9:00pm and 11:00pm - Wizard Tower[/size]
[*][size=2]Ask Farmer - Must have seen the Home sick event - Between 5:00pm and 10:00pm - Farmhouse[/size]
[*][size=2]Magnus Talk with morgan - Must have seen the Ask Farmer Event, this will unlock the hability to adopt Morgan using the Adoption registry at Harvey's Office. (This is regardles of the answer you give Magnus.) - between 8:00am and 5:00pm- Wizard Basement[/size]
[*][size=2]Commute - Must Have adopted Morgan - Between 6:10am and 8:00am - Farmouse[/size]
[/list]
[center][b][size=4]Aditional adoption pre-requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]Have Farmhouse upgraded to lvl 2 (have access to cribs)
[/list]
[b][size=4][center]How to Install:[/center][center]﻿[/center][/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Download the main File of this mod into your mod folder.
[*]unzip it and you are ready to go.
[/list]
[b][center][size=4]Known issues:
[/size][/center][/b][list]
[*]"RRRR baby events trigger weirdly after adopting Morgan"-- A: Highly recommend to adopt Morgan AFTER having 2 kids with Magnus, If you don't want to, just skip the events and it will be fine.
[/list]
[list]
[*]"Morgan's Portrait won't load as intended when using Portraiture for custom portraits"  -- A: Triying to resolve the issue, for a quick fix please simply replace Morgan's SVE portrait file with the one that's intended to use in Portraiture. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]"Morgan is not waking up at home on some days" --A: On the day's 2, 3 ,7, 13, 18, 26 of each season, Morgan takes special classes with Magnus and does not come home for that night.
[*]"Stuck after "Ask Farmer" event" --A: "This error occurs only if you are using Grandpa's Farm, simply type on the SMAPI console "debug warp town"
[/list]
If you ancounter any other issue, please feel free to make a post about it (Reccomended to show your SMAPI Log)
